high_level_description: A bold typographic concert poster for an indie folk band, with a centered title, a subtitle, a date, a tagline, a credit line, and an RSVP line, all on a textured midnight-blue field.

style_description.aesthetics: bold, typographic, indie editorial, high contrast, retro poster
style_description.lighting: even flat lighting with a single subtle paper grain overlay
style_description.art_style: modern typographic poster, generous kerning, mixed serif display and clean sans-serif body, distressed paper texture overlay

compositional_deconstruction.background: A textured midnight-blue rectangular field with a faint off-white paper grain. A single thin warm-orange horizontal rule sits just above the title baseline. No imagery, no gradient.

elements.desc: Very large all-caps serif display title, off-white, centered horizontally, with generous letter-spacing.
Medium italic serif subtitle in warm orange, centered just below the title.
Small all-caps sans-serif date and venue line in off-white, centered, with two small dot separators.
Small italic serif tagline in muted sage green, centered, with curly quotes.
Tiny all-caps sans-serif supporting credit in off-white at 70% opacity, centered.
Small all-caps sans-serif RSVP line in warm orange, centered, the URL in the same off-white as the rest of the type.
